name: Natural Scene Beauty: Minimum Semantic Content Images
description: Faithful replication with the paper's own stimuli: participants rate the beauty of natural-scene images with little semantic content (trees, sky, foliage, rocks, terrain) from 1 (very ugly) to 5 (very beautiful), using the paper's instruction. As in the paper, 10 practice images manipulated to look very beautiful or very ugly come first in random order and are not analysed; then each participant rates at least 14 images drawn at random from the pool, and may rate more in sets of 7. Rebuilt from Penacchio, Javed, Raducanu, Otazu & Parraga (2026), Scientific Data 13: 470, with images from the MSC database on OSF (10.17605/OSF.IO/ZGSVJ, CC0 1.0). The pool is a random sample of 200 of the 10,426 images, stratified like the full database: 109 unmodified, 57 auto-uglified, 18 beautified and 16 uglified; the page stores each image's category and its crowdsourced rating (100 votes; mean and fitted mu). Analysis as in the paper: per-image mean beauty, compared with the stored crowd values (Spearman correlation) and across categories; relate ratings to low-level image statistics (the paper used the aesthetics toolbox of Redies et al.). Differences from the original study: (1) 200 of the 10,426 images, so each image gets far fewer ratings unless many people take part; (2) the 10 practice images are our choice: the five beautified images with the highest and the five uglified images with the lowest crowd ratings (kept out of the main pool); (3) the original ran on a crowdsourcing platform inside an online game, without demographics, as here; (4) images were re-encoded as JPEG (quality 80) to fit the upload limit; (5) the paper names only the end points (1 very ugly, 5 very beautiful); the labels for 2-4 (ugly, neutral, beautiful) are ours.
author: Penacchio, Javed, Raducanu, Otazu & Parraga

.btn:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed}
.prog{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px}
.view{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:5}
.view img{width:min(96vw,720px);height:auto;display:block}
.cross{font-size:48px;color:#333;font-weight:300}
.thumb{width:100%;max-width:420px;border-radius:8px;display:block;margin:0 auto 12px}
.bi{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:10px}.bi .l{text-align:right;font-size:.88rem}.bi .r{font-size:.88rem}.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,40px);gap:4px}
.row label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:6px 0;cursor:pointer;font-size:.82rem}
.row label:has(input:checked){background:var(--sel);border-color:var(--accent)}
.row input{margin:0 0 2px}
@media(max-width:520px){.bi{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.bi .row{grid-column:1/-1;order:3;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}.bi .l{text-align:left}.bi .r{text-align:right}}
.ends{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
textarea{width:100%;font:inherit;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;min-height:60px}
label.opt{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer}
.f{margin-top:16px}
input[type=number]{font:inherit;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;width:110px}
.err{color:var(--warn);margin-top:8px;min-height:1.2em}
.credit{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 24px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}
.stim{display:block;margin:0 auto 14px;max-width:100%;max-height:58vh;border-radius:6px}
.r5{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px}
.r5 label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 2px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.78rem;text-align:center;line-height:1.2}
.r5 label:has(input:checked){background:var(--sel);border-color:var(--accent)}
.r5 b{font-size:1.1rem}
.row2{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main id="app" aria-live="polite"><p>Loading…</p></main>
<footer class="credit">Images: Minimum Semantic Content (MSC) database, Penacchio, Javed, Raducanu, Otazu & Parraga (2026), Scientific Data 13: 470 (doi:10.1038/s41597-026-06816-0); OSF 10.17605/OSF.IO/ZGSVJ, CC0 1.0.</footer>
<script>
(function(){
  var KEY='msc-beauty:state', MIN=14, MORE=7;
  var LAB=['Very ugly','Ugly','Neutral','Beautiful','Very beautiful'];
  var app=document.getElementById('app'), Q={}, P={}, S={}, pids=[], sids=[], st=null;
  function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"'}[c];});}
  function err(m){var e=app.querySelector('.err');if(e)e.textContent=m||'';}
  function ok(r){return !(r&&r.ok===false);}
  function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(st));}catch(e){}}
  function shuffle(a){a=a.slice();for(var i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)),t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;}return a;}
  function send(list,b,next){if(b)b.disabled=true;Promise.all(list).then(function(rs){var bad=rs.filter(function(r){return !ok(r);})[0];if(bad){if(b)b.disabled=false;return err(bad.error);}next();});}
  function val(name){var x=app.querySelector('input[name="'+name+'"]:checked');return x?x.value:null;}
  function load(f,id){(SPSite.getMedia(f)||[]).forEach(function(m){if(/\.(png|jpe?g|webp)$/i.test(m.name)){var k=m.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,'');(f==='practice'?P:S)[k]=m;(f==='practice'?pids:sids).push(k);}});}
  function intro(){
    app.innerHTML='<h1>How beautiful is this image?</h1><p>You will see pictures of natural scenes and materials, such as trees, rocks, sky and water. Some have been changed on purpose. For each picture, rate its beauty from 1 (very ugly) to 5 (very beautiful). First come '+st.practice.length+' practice pictures, then at least '+MIN+' pictures for the study. It takes about 5 minutes.</p><div class="card"><label class="opt" style="margin-top:0"><input type="checkbox" id="ok"> '+esc(Q.consent.title)+'</label><div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn" id="go">Start</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){if(!document.getElementById('ok').checked)return err('Consent is needed to continue.');send([SPSite.answer('consent',true)],this,function(){st.step='practice';st.k=0;save();route();});};
  }
  function trial(practice){
    var list=practice?st.practice:st.main,k=st.k,id=list[k],f=practice?P[id]:S[id],h='<div class="r5">';
    for(var i=1;i<=5;i++)h+='<label><input type="radio" name="q" value="'+i+'"><b>'+i+'</b>'+LAB[i-1]+'</label>';h+='</div>';
    var prog=practice?'Practice '+(k+1)+' of '+list.length:'Picture '+(k+1)+(k<st.target?' of '+st.target:'');
    app.innerHTML='<div class="prog">'+prog+'</div><div class="card"><img class="stim" alt="Natural scene picture" src="'+esc(f.url)+'"><p style="color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:8px">Rate the beauty of this image from 1 (very ugly) to 5 (very beautiful).</p>'+h+'<div class="row2"><button class="btn" id="go">Next</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){
      var v=val('q');if(v==null)return err('Please choose a rating.');
      send([SPSite.answer(practice?'practice_beauty':'beauty',Number(v),{key:id,shown:[f.name]})],this,function(){
        st.k++;
        if(practice&&st.k>=list.length){st.step='ready';st.k=0;}
        else if(!practice&&(st.k>=st.target||st.k>=list.length))st.step='more';
        save();route();});
    };
  }
  function ready(){
    app.innerHTML='<h2>Practice done</h2><div class="card"><p style="color:var(--ink)">Now the study begins. Rate each picture in the same way, from 1 (very ugly) to 5 (very beautiful). There are no right or wrong answers.</p><button class="btn" id="go">Begin</button></div>';
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){st.step='main';save();route();};
  }
  function more(){
    var left=st.main.length-st.k;
    app.innerHTML='<h2>Thank you, that is enough for the study</h2><div class="card"><p style="color:var(--ink)">You have rated '+st.k+' pictures. You may rate a few more if you like, or finish now.</p><div class="row2">'+(left>0?'<button class="btn sec" id="more" style="background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line)">Rate '+Math.min(MORE,left)+' more</button>':'')+'<button class="btn" id="fin">Finish</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    var m=document.getElementById('more');if(m)m.onclick=function(){st.target=Math.min(st.main.length,st.k+MORE);st.step='main';save();route();};
    document.getElementById('fin').onclick=function(){st.step='done';save();route();};
  }
  function finish(){
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Thank you!</h1><div class="card"><p id="fin">Submitting…</p><div class="err"></div></div>';
    SPSite.complete().then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){err(r.error||'Some answers are missing.');setTimeout(function(){st.step='intro';save();route();},1800);}
      else{try{localStorage.removeItem(KEY);}catch(e){}var s=document.getElementById('fin');if(s)s.textContent='Your answers are saved.';}});
  }
  function route(){var s=st.step;window.scrollTo(0,0);if(s==='practice')return trial(true);if(s==='ready')return ready();if(s==='main')return trial(false);if(s==='more')return more();if(s==='done')return finish();intro();}
  SPSite.onReady(function(ctx){
    ['consent','practice_beauty','beauty'].forEach(function(n){Q[n]=SPSite.getQuestion(n)||{};});
    load('practice');load('scenes');
    if(sids.length<MIN){app.innerHTML='<h1>Images missing</h1><p>Upload the pictures to the media folders "practice" and "scenes".</p>';return;}
    try{st=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY));}catch(e){st=null;}
    var valid=st&&st.main&&st.main.every(function(x){return S[x];})&&st.practice.every(function(x){return P[x];});
    if(!valid)st={step:'intro',practice:shuffle(pids),main:shuffle(sids),k:0,target:MIN};
    var a=(ctx&&ctx.answers)||{};if(a.consent!==true){st.step='intro';st.k=0;st.target=MIN;}
    save();route();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

config.description: Faithful replication with the paper's own stimuli: participants rate the beauty of natural-scene images with little semantic content (trees, sky, foliage, rocks, terrain) from 1 (very ugly) to 5 (very beautiful), using the paper's instruction. As in the paper, 10 practice images manipulated to look very beautiful or very ugly come first in random order and are not analysed; then each participant rates at least 14 images drawn at random from the pool, and may rate more in sets of 7. Rebuilt from Penacchio, Javed, Raducanu, Otazu & Parraga (2026), Scientific Data 13: 470, with images from the MSC database on OSF (10.17605/OSF.IO/ZGSVJ, CC0 1.0). The pool is a random sample of 200 of the 10,426 images, stratified like the full database: 109 unmodified, 57 auto-uglified, 18 beautified and 16 uglified; the page stores each image's category and its crowdsourced rating (100 votes; mean and fitted mu). Analysis as in the paper: per-image mean beauty, compared with the stored crowd values (Spearman correlation) and across categories; relate ratings to low-level image statistics (the paper used the aesthetics toolbox of Redies et al.). Differences from the original study: (1) 200 of the 10,426 images, so each image gets far fewer ratings unless many people take part; (2) the 10 practice images are our choice: the five beautified images with the highest and the five uglified images with the lowest crowd ratings (kept out of the main pool); (3) the original ran on a crowdsourcing platform inside an online game, without demographics, as here; (4) images were re-encoded as JPEG (quality 80) to fit the upload limit; (5) the paper names only the end points (1 very ugly, 5 very beautiful); the labels for 2-4 (ugly, neutral, beautiful) are ours.

paper.title: The Minimum Semantic Content (MSC) Dataset: A Large, Balanced Resource for Computational Aesthetics Research
